name: kondi-discord-mcp
description: MCP server providing Discord API tools for messaging, channels, and reactions

tools.name: discord_send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a Discord channel. Supports plain text and optional embed.

tools.name: discord_get_messages
tools.description: Retrieve recent messages from a Discord channel.

tools.name: discord_get_channel
tools.description: Get information about a Discord channel.

tools.name: discord_list_guild_channels
tools.description: List all channels in a Discord guild (server).

tools.name: discord_create_reaction
tools.description: Add a reaction emoji to a message in a Discord channel.
